g.text: tile ID = TCA9548A address: 3 solder jumpers to GND (closed = 0), 10k pull-ups to +3V3 (open = 1); address 0x70 + ID. Test pads only (all 26 ribbon pins are used)

g.text: TCA9548A per tile: host SDA/SCL (ribbon, pulled up on the carrier) -> ch0 -> UDAC0, ch1 -> UDAC1; ch2..7 unused. RESET tied to +3V3. Channel pull-ups RPU1..4 10k to +3V3
